summary: Iteration 2: retested the 2 reported bugs and the regression fixes from iteration 1. Bug 1 (unknown tool loop): the unit test gives 'model calls: 2' and the run is interrupted. One real chat ('Rode npm install e depois liste os arquivos', qwen/qwen3-coder-next) finished with a done event in 14.6s. The model said it cannot run npm/ls, used only real tools and made no unknown-tool calls. A second chat sent during that run got 409. Bug 2 (GitHub import): the validation paths work (400 'Conecte o GitHub' on both endpoints, 409 when the project has files, 404 for another user's project, 422 for a bad body, and /projects/import leaves no orphan project). Real zip import could not be tested because there is no PAT; it was code-reviewed only. Regression: '..' returns 400 on PUT, DELETE, asset and upload. 8 concurrent saves produced versions 1..8. Save, upload, restore and delete give versions 1..5 in order. Frontend: tree-empty, tree-import-github-btn, import-github-dialog, github-not-connected and the 'Ir para Configurações' link all work. chat-empty mentions Importar do GitHub. Dashboard, Settings and Admin are centered. The Admin Limite input shows 'Carregando…' and is disabled while loading. Smoke test: the project 90476221 preview renders and the Desktop/Celular toggle works.

minor.issue: There is still a race between the RUNNING check and the place where it is set. The check is on line 334 and the set is on line 356, with awaits in between (get_settings, resolve_key, messages.insert_one). Two chat requests sent at the same moment can both pass the check. The step-by-step case works (409 confirmed). Fix: move RUNNING[pid] = uid to just after the check and pop it on every early exit (429/402).

RUNNING is not set during the import, so a chat can start while files are being inserted. Also, two imports at the same moment both pass count==0; the second insert_many then hits a duplicate key and its except block runs db.files.delete_many({project_id}), which deletes the files of the import that succeeded. Fix: mark RUNNING[pid] during the import, or use an import lock, and only delete the files this call inserted.

The whole zipball is loaded into memory (r.content) with no size limit, and zf.read runs synchronously on the event loop. A large repo can block or OOM the backend. Zip entry paths are not passed through clean_path, so names with '..' could be stored. Fix: check the content-length (for example max 100 MB), run the extraction in a threadpool, and apply clean_path.
The import does not create a version (record_version), so it does not appear in Versões and cannot be used as a restore baseline. This may be intended, but note it.
If the project is deleted while the agent is running, find_one_and_update returns None and proj['version_seq'] raises TypeError inside Agent.run finally. Guard against proj being None.

ui_bugs.issue: The Salvar button stays enabled while the settings load, and also when the input is empty. save() sends Number('') = 0, which sets the platform daily limit to US$0 and silently blocks every user on the platform key. Disable Salvar until s is loaded and v is a valid number, and validate before the PUT. I did not click it.

issues: 'Importar do GitHub' in the chat empty state is a purple span that looks like a link but cannot be clicked. Make it a button that opens the import dialog.

The same hint shows on projects that already have files (for example 'Teste', with 5 files and no messages). Those projects have no import button and the backend would answer 409. Show the hint only when files.length === 0.

action_items: Admin LimitTab: disable Salvar while loading or when the input is empty or invalid (it can set daily_limit_usd to 0)
chat endpoint: set RUNNING[pid] right after the check, before any await, and clear it on 402/429 exits
github import into a project: hold RUNNING or a lock during the import, and on error do not delete files inserted by another call
import_repo: limit the zip size, run zip extraction off the event loop, and clean_path the entry paths
Make the chat-empty 'Importar do GitHub' clickable and show it only for empty projects
critical_code_review_comments: agent.py unknown_streak: correct. It counts unknown tools, resets on a known tool call, and stops after 2 with a note and a tool_error event. Edge case: if the JSON is invalid on a known tool call, the streak is not reset, which is acceptable.
SYSTEM_PROMPT clearly states there is no terminal/shell/git and lists the 6 tools. The real model followed it.

The model over-reached on 'npm install': it also rewrote package.json and created index.js, App.js and App.css without being asked. This is model behavior, not a bug, but the prompt could say 'do not create files the user did not ask for'.
server.py is 669 lines, close to the 700-line limit. Consider splitting the GitHub and admin routes into routers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested checks; 1 medium bug found outside them (Admin Salvar)
